stem:
The box plots summarize the attendance for the spring musical and the fall musical. Each musical was performed for six evenings.

Spring musical: (box plot)

Fall musical: (box plot)

Which statement best describes the data represented in the box plots?

options.label: F
options.text: The range in attendance for the fall musical is 85.

options.label: G
options.text: The interquartile range for the spring musical is 45.

options.label: H
options.text: For half the evenings at the fall musical, the attendance was less than 160 people.

options.label: J
options.text: For half the evenings at the spring musical, the attendance was between 155 and 200 people.

visual_elements: Box plots for Spring musical and Fall musical attendance on number line 120 to 230
